nodes.label: Token Composition Fallback (e.g. CGFloat.Spacing.xxs + 2). Rationale: don't extend the design system mid-feature and don't write magic numbers — composition keeps the relationship to the design system explicit and reviewable; 3+ repeats of the same composition signal a genuinely needed new token
